description: Endpoint doesn't exist in URL configuration

diagnostic_steps.step: Search for URL path in backend urls.py
diagnostic_steps.rationale: Confirms whether route exists at all

diagnostic_steps.step: Check if view class exists and is imported
diagnostic_steps.rationale: URL may reference view that isn't exported

diagnostic_steps.command: Check main urls.py for include() statement
diagnostic_steps.rationale: Module URLs may not be included in root config

diagnostic_steps.command: Compare frontend URL vs backend prefix (/api/v2/ vs /api/v1/)

common_bugs.symptom: Frontend calls endpoint that doesn't exist
common_bugs.fix: Create view class, register in urls.py and views/__init__.py

common_bugs.symptom: New endpoint returns 404 despite code being correct
common_bugs.cause: Django dev server didn't reload after adding new URLs
common_bugs.fix: Restart Django server: python manage.py runserver

common_bugs.cause: Trailing slash mismatch or typo in path
common_bugs.fix: Compare exact frontend URL with urls.py path definition

fix_template.create_view:
1. Create view in views/
2. Add import to views/__init__.py
3. Add path() to urls.py
4. Restart server
